prompt: The video begins with the viewer moving forward along a narrow path flanked by tall metal railings, leading into a dense forest under a cloudy, foggy night sky. As the camera advances steadily, the path opens up to reveal a series of red torii gates lining a stone pathway, creating a tunnel-like effect through the misty woods. The camera continues its forward motion, passing through each gate, with the dim ambient light casting soft shadows among the trees. The scene transitions to a paved courtyard bordered by traditional Japanese architecture, featuring wooden structures with tiled roofs. The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the courtyard's layout, including a small building with glowing red lanterns that cast a warm, eerie glow. The camera then moves into a covered walkway lined with red pillars and more lanterns, intensifying the red hue as it progresses deeper into the structure. The camera angle remains at eye level throughout, maintaining a consistent perspective as it navigates through the increasingly illuminated corridor, with the red lighting dominating the visual field and enhancing the mysterious atmosphere of the night-time setting.
